materials.text: Match each invoice against the purchase order and goods receipt. Investigate mismatches above 2%. Record the reconciliation result in the finance system.
For a normal invoice, I match the purchase order, check the goods receipt, and record the result. If the mismatch exceeds 2%, I investigate it before processing.

scenarios.title: Urgent supplier payment exception
scenarios.responsibility: Handle urgent supplier payments when standard approval is delayed

materials.text: Payments require approval from the finance manager before release. Urgent payments should be prioritised.
When a payment is urgent, I usually message the finance manager. If they are unavailable, I contact someone who can help. We have a workaround for critical suppliers.

scenarios.title: Month-end reconciliation dependency
scenarios.responsibility: Complete month-end reconciliation using the sales export

materials.text: Download the sales export, reconcile totals against the finance ledger, investigate discrepancies, and submit the reconciliation by the second working day.

I download the export from the reporting portal. If the export is delayed, I normally ask Priya because she knows which report to use. The replacement report sometimes has different columns, so I adjust the spreadsheet before reconciling.

scenarios.title: Demonstration without assessed outcome
scenarios.responsibility: Prepare and submit the weekly operations report

materials.text: Compile weekly operational totals, compare them with the previous week, explain material deviations, and submit the report to the operations manager.
The successor recorded a demonstration of preparing and submitting the weekly report. No assessment result or reviewer sign-off was recorded.

scenarios.title: Verified routine reporting
scenarios.responsibility: Prepare and submit the daily operations report

materials.text: Export daily totals, validate the totals against the source system, investigate discrepancies above 1%, and submit the report before 10:00.

Assessment criterion: independently produce a report with totals matching the source system, investigate discrepancies above 1%, and submit before 10:00. Recorded outcome: passed. Evidence: assessor-reviewed task output. Reviewer: operations manager. Verification status: confirmed.

scenarios.title: Stakeholder-dependent customer escalation
scenarios.responsibility: Resolve customer escalations that require coordination with account management

materials.text: Log the complaint, assess severity, and escalate high-priority cases to account management.

For certain long-standing customers, I speak to their account manager before sending the standard escalation email. Some accounts have agreed exceptions, and the relationship history changes how we approach the conversation.
